ownership: Documentation only; no browser/native input, production change, staging or commit.

captureWebScript.nativeNamesToWeb: NORMAL->normal; BUMP_HALT->bumpHalt; preserve phase/length numerically. Prefer recorded Web animation strings when aligning, never relabel a mismatched state.

matchingRules: Attempts and accepted turns are distinct; retain blocked inputs in event delivery. All indices under perInput are 1-based.
Use native history-before:TurnCompleted for accepted Movement.moves; later preview recomputation reuses the scratch list.
Native raw movement/focus block indices can differ from pruned structural snapshot indices. Do not equate them by number alone.
captureWebOptions.events use observed native eventStartMs and observed release-minus-press duration from actual capture metadata, not synthetic accepted-only timing.
Declared source schedule is each direction40ms then NONE650ms. Native observed timings include instrumented frame boundaries; browser actual dispatch timestamps must be retained and checked.
Native primary phase anchors select actual saved PNGs nearest target phases and retain actual phase and error. Requested target labels are not actual observed phases.
A null native image is unsupported image evidence even when state metadata exists. No missing frame is rendered or interpolated.
Compare actual player identity/state, animation kind/length/phase and camera phase before image comparison. Do not compare by nominal elapsed time alone.
Native terminal PNGs can retain BUMP_HALT offsets although AnyBlockMoving is false; structural endpoint equality does not establish equal final animation phase.
These contracts cover the native retained direction routes only; undo/redo/restart, extra setup, suffix inputs and generated-zone claims need their own evidence.
